async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill in the title field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)").fill("Let's keep the project alive")
    # Step 2: Assign the issue to myself

    try:
        await page.get_by_text("Assign to me").click()
    except:
        # If 'Assign to me' not found, try to set assignee via dropdown
        await page.get_by_label("Assignee").click()
        await page.get_by_text("Assign to me").click()
    # Step 3: Set the due date to end of Q1 2033 (March 31, 2033)
    await page.get_by_label("Due date").fill("2033-03-31")
    # Step 4: Submit the issue
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
